question: The word “inclusive” means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Allowing everyone to participate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"inclusive"** means:

 
 
• Allowing everyone to participate without any restrictions or limitations. (सबको शामिल करने वाला)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The company aims to build an inclusive culture that values and respects diverse backgrounds.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Allowing everyone to participate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strict and limited** (सख्त और सीमित): Imposing rigorous restrictions; not allowing flexibility or variation.

 
 
• **Example:** The rules of the competition were strict and limited, allowing no exceptions.
 
 
 
• **Only for selected people** (केवल चयनित लोगों के लिए): Accessible or available only to a specific group.
 
 
• **Example:** The event was exclusive, intended only for selected people within the organization.
 
 
 
• **Unrelated or irrelevant** (असंबंधित या अप्रासंगिक): Not connected with or related to the matter at hand.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments were unrelated or irrelevant, adding no value to the discussion.
